;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Syria|Syrian state]] media report that more than 50 civilians are injured in a suspected [[poison gas]] attack by [[Syrian rebels]] on [[Aleppo]]. [https://www.smh.com.au/world/middle-east/syria-accuses-rebels-of-poison-gas-attack-in-aleppo-20181125-p50i6d.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Traffic accidents in India]]
**A bus crash in [[Karnataka]], [[India]], leaves at least 25 people dead as the vehicle sinks into a canal. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/nov/24/schoolchildren-among-the-dead-in-indian-bus-crash (''The Guardian'')]
*At least 35 people died after a cruise boat carrying party revellers capsized on [[Lake Victoria]], [[Uganda]]. [https://edition-m.cnn.com/2018/11/25/africa/uganda-boat-accident-intl/index.html?r=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.it%2F (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**The [[Government of Spain|Spanish government]] and the [[Government of the United Kingdom|UK government]] reach an agreement on [[Gibraltar]] whereby Spain lifts its threat of boycotting Sunday's summit on Brexit. [[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] says there are now "sufficient guarantees" that any future decisions regarding Gibraltar would be made with Spain. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2018/11/24/world/europe/24reuters-britain-eu-gibraltar.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/britain-eu-sanchez/spains-sanchez-confirms-deal-reached-over-gibraltar-idUSL8N1XZ0BS (Reuters)]
*[[Mexico–United States relations]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] announces that migrants seeking asylum at the southern border will wait in Mexico while their claims are processed in U.S. courts. Mexico's incoming foreign minister [[Marcelo Ebrard]] denies an agreement has been reached, and says "(no) specific proposal" has been received from the United States. [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]]'s administration will take power next Saturday, December 1. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2018/11/24/u-s-mexican-government-reach-deal-handling-asylum-seekers-report/2101037002/ (''USA Today'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46333119 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Taiwan]]
**[[President of the Republic of China|Taiwanese President]] [[Tsai Ing-wen]] resigns as [[List of leaders of the Democratic Progressive Party|leader of the Democratic Progressives]] and refuses [[Premier of the Republic of China|Prime Minister]] [[William Lai]]'s offer to quit after a major defeat in [[Taiwanese local elections, 2018|local elections]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-politics-president/taiwan-president-resigns-as-ruling-party-chairwoman-after-election-defeats-idUSKCN1NT0HO (Reuters)] [https://www.apnews.com/bfe77bf1843947e58c26c40897f8762d (Associated Press)]
**[[Same-sex marriage in Taiwan]]
***Referendum voters in Taiwan reject [[2018 Taiwanese referendum|a proposal to allow same-sex marriage]]. A March 2017 [[Judicial Yuan|Constitutional Court]] ruling found the ban on these unions unconstitutional and ordered  parliament to change the law within two years. Earlier, the government said the results of this vote would not affect its complying with the court's decision. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46329877 (BBC)]
*[[Yellow vests movement]]
**Violent clashes between [[France|French]] police and protesters last well into the night on the [[Champs-Élysées]] in [[Paris]] over rising fuel taxes. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-protests/french-police-clash-violently-with-protesters-on-champs-elysees-over-petrol-costs-idUSKCN1NS2EC (Reuters)]
*[[National security#United Kingdom|United Kingdom national security]], [[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
**The [[British Army]] [[Chief of the General Staff (United Kingdom)|Chief of the General Staff]], [[Mark Carleton-Smith]], says [[Russia]] is a "far greater threat" to the United Kingdom's national security than the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-46327046 (BBC)]
;Sports
*[[World Chess Championship 2018]]
**After eleven consecutive draws, a record for the 132-year-old championship, [[Magnus Carlsen]] and [[Fabiano Caruana]] are tied 5.5 points each in the best-of-12-games match. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/live/2018/nov/24/magnus-carlsen-v-fabiano-caruana-world-chess-championship-game-11-live (''The Guardian'')]
